title: No Signal Rainbow
steps: Ensure the camera is powered on and the lens cap is removed.
Ensure the camera is set to the correct output mode (HDMI/SDI). " Menu" > "REC/OUT SET" > "Video Out" > "Output Select" > HDMI/SDI
If using an external monitor, ensure it is set to the correct input source.
Restart the camera and try again.

title: Camera Not Focusing
steps: Ensure the lens is set to auto-focus mode.
Check if the camera is in manual focus mode and switch it to auto-focus.
Clean the lens contacts and ensure they are free of dust or debris.
Try switching to a different lens if available.

title: Not Getting Audio
steps: Ensure the correct mic input is selected in the camera settings.
Ensure you are sending the signal out via the XLR cable.
Raise the gain using the knobs on the side of the camera attachment (Signal may be very low).
